purpose: Add an explicit engineering candidate-separation acceptance layer to completed C-LAMBDA and C-WLS runs without modifying their paper-core solver or frozen V3 results.
paper_requirement: Neither source specifies this ratio acceptance layer for the implemented single-baseline estimator. This is a new engineering extension, not a repair of an omitted paper step.
threshold_source: One prespecified project engineering setting, inherited numerically from the already registered DD-KF ratio threshold. Not calibrated against the commercial reference and not asserted to control an integer failure probability.
EXT01_cost: Existing exact constrained-ILS best and second objectives, relative to the joint-float residual; require original global best/second certificate.
EXT02_cost: Existing full wrapped code/phase objective from every converged saved Algorithm-2 candidate; collapse identical integer vectors by minimum objective, then use best and second distinct integer hypotheses. Original entire-pool convergence is required; this does not create a global C-WLS certificate.
cost_scales: The objective offsets differ between EXT01 and EXT02. A common numeric threshold is an engineering comparison, not a shared calibrated statistical guarantee.
rules: Never override a native invalid epoch or search/candidate failure.
Require two distinct integer hypotheses and finite nonnegative costs in sorted order.
Best cost exactly zero has undefined finite ratio and is withheld as ZERO_BEST_COST, regardless of reference.
Accept only when second/best >= 3.0; equality passes.
Retain all original epochs and native failure reasons in the denominator.
Freeze acceptance masks before joining the already saved error series.
No threshold search, reference-driven selection, raw solver rerun, or change to V3.
